offer.text: A map eats paper like nothing else. Twelve sheets and I can chart the next valley.

accept.text: Excellent. The blank spaces won't fill themselves.

decline.text: The edges of the map stay a mystery, then.

in_progress.text: Have you found me any paper?

ready.text: Twelve sheets — enough for a proper survey. My thanks.

complete.text: I'll mark something useful for you on the next map.
